title: lastrea flaccida
intro: Lastrea flaccida, commonly known as the Ruffled Shield Fern, is a species of fern native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea flaccida include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activities, making it a potential agent in the treatment of various infectious diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
